evidence_quotes: vanwege het niet emissiearm uitrijden van mest als bedoeld in art. 5 Besluit gebruik meststoffen.
rationale: This Dutch Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal (CBb) decision concerns a 20% Common Agricultural Policy (GLB) cross-compliance subsidy reduction (randvoorwaardenkorting) imposed for failing to apply manure using low-emission methods under Article 5 of the Besluit gebruik meststoffen. Agricultural manure regulation and CAP subsidy compliance fall squarely outside water law and water governance under the coding protocol.
